title.suggested: Hogan Trains for His Fight with Allen

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Ben Hogan was training for his coming fight with Tom Allen, while Allen, confident of victory, had not begun training and was 'lushing' considerably.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The St. Louis Democrat, Wednesday, October 1, 1873 (Daily Democrat). Before the 1875 Globe-Democrat merger.

facts.fact: Allen was matched to fight Ben Hogan; as of October 1 he had not begun training and planned to start only a few days before the fight

notes: Also notes McCoole was still recovering from his fight with Allen.
